sql: SELECT "player"."Club_ID" AS k, (CAST("player"."Points" AS REAL) / "player"."Apps") AS m1 FROM "player" WHERE (CAST("player"."Points" AS REAL) / "player"."Apps") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
why: points scored / appearances: the catalogue declares points scored a rate over appearances
rank player rows by points scored per appearances

sql: SELECT "player"."Club_ID" AS k, (CAST("player"."Apps" AS REAL) / "player"."Tries") AS m1 FROM "player" WHERE (CAST("player"."Apps" AS REAL) / "player"."Tries") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
why: appearances / tries scored: a ratio of two quantities in count
rank player rows by appearances relative to tries scored

sql: SELECT "player"."Club_ID" AS k, (CAST("player"."Tries" AS REAL) / "player"."Apps") AS m1 FROM "player" WHERE (CAST("player"."Tries" AS REAL) / "player"."Apps") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
why: tries scored / appearances: a ratio of two quantities in count
rank player rows by tries scored relative to appearances

sql: SELECT "player"."Club_ID" AS k, (CAST("player"."Tries" AS REAL) / "player"."Points") AS m1 FROM "player" WHERE (CAST("player"."Tries" AS REAL) / "player"."Points") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
why: tries scored / points scored: the catalogue declares tries scored part of points scored
rank player rows by tries scored per points scored

sql: SELECT "player"."Club_ID" AS k, ("player"."Apps" - "player"."Tries") AS m1 FROM "player" WHERE ("player"."Apps" - "player"."Tries") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
why: appearances - tries scored: both in count and of the same kind (flows) on the same one player
rank player rows by appearances minus tries scored
